title: TRUCK AIR HOCKEY
prompt: Create ORIGINAL finished TRANSPARENT title logo for a 1998 PS1 mascot arcade game. The reference Dock Diving artwork defines the REQUIRED VISUAL STYLE: VERY CHUNKY WOBBLY UNEVEN hand-drawn letters with simple angular sculpted bevels; thick blue-black outline, ivory keyline; bold 3-tone cel-painted color planes. Any semi trucks must be obviously LOW-POLY TOY CARTOON trucks with enormous wheels and simple surfaces. NO realistic trucks, NO photographic wood/ice/metal, NO glossy highlights, NO microscopic detail. SIMPLIFIED FACETED SHAPES like early 3D console box artwork, but crisp high-resolution image. Invent a unique composition, not the reference layout. NO scene background or panel; genuine alpha transparency and ample clear margins. Accurate fully legible lettering, no obscuring letters. Exact title: "TRUCK AIR HOCKEY". Composition: Purple and lime painted AIR bubble letters, flat red cartoon striker integrated with a tiny cab at left, a simple puck swoosh as underline. No arena background, no chrome and no shiny inflatable surfaces.
